Peanut Butter Magic Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:32am

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 cup cocoa
1/2 teaspoon soda
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup margarine, softened
1/4 cup peanut butter
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 egg
3/4 cup peanut butter
3/4 cup powdered sugar

Preparation

1 1. Combine filling ingredients and blend well. Form into 30 (1-inch) 2 Balls. Set aside. 3 2. Beat sugars, margarine, and peanut butter until light and fluffy. 4 Add rest of ingredients. 5 3. With floured hands, take about 1 T dough and wrap around p.butter ball, covering completely. Place 2" apart on ungreased cookie sheet. 6 Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. 7 4. Bake at 375 for 7-9 min or until set and slightly cracked. Cool on wire racks. About 30 cookies.
